name: Pokémon Emerald
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Pokemon Emerald teams, which differ from Ruby/Sapphire in several places: Roxanne fields two Geodude, Wattson adds Electrike and a Manectric ace, Flannery and Norman have reworked teams, Tate & Liza field four Pokemon, Juan replaces Wallace as 8th Gym Leader, and Wallace is the Champion. Elite Four changes vs Ruby/Sapphire: Sidney's Sharpedo becomes Crawdaunt; Drake trades one Flygon for Kingdra. Species and levels from Bulbapedia party data; abilities/items/moves intentionally blank in v1.
